definition: Pine, oak and conifer forest of the Eje Neovolcánico and sierras.
key_features: Rough natural texture (no rows); evergreen conifer stays green in dry; oak semi-deciduous. Separate from avocado by geometry + irrigation.

definition: Deciduous dry forest of coastal ranges (Jal/Col/Mich/Nay).
key_features: GREEN in wet season, brown/leafless in dry -> very high dNDVI. Low-mid elevation.

definition: Xerophytic scrub of the arid altiplano (Zac/SLP/Ags).
key_features: Sparse, low NDVI both seasons; must NOT be lumped into forest.

definition: Natural grassland + induced pasture for livestock.
key_features: Herbaceous, strong wet-season green-up, low structure.
Dense dark-green EVERGREEN, hillslope terraces, orchard rows at VHR, LOW dNDVI (stays green), HIGH NDMI (irrigation), reservoirs (ollas) nearby.

definition: Blue agave (Los Altos / DO Tequila, Jalisco + others).
key_features: Blue-grey rosettes in rows, wide BARE inter-row (red soil), high BSI, low-mid NDVI, strong geometric texture, stable across seasons.

definition: Woody/perennial crops other than avocado/agave: citrus, mango, open berry.
key_features: Tree/bush crops with rows; use NDRE + phenology to split from avocado & forest.
Very bright white/blue plastic or mesh; extreme visible reflectance; geometric blocks.

definition: Rainfed + irrigated annual field crops (maize, sorghum, beans; sugarcane).
key_features: Geometric fields, strong bare<->green phenology (high dNDVI), irrigation districts / center pivots.

definition: Cities, towns, roads and built infrastructure.
key_features: Bright/grey, geometric, high NDBI, low NDVI both seasons.

definition: Exposed soil, fallow, quarries, dry lakebeds, and fresh clearings.
key_features: High BSI, low NDVI both seasons; captures recent forest-to-bare conversion as a direct cross-check on the deforestation alerts.
Low NIR, dark, high MNDWI; reservoirs shrink in dry season.
